Specification: This module, LiveHourClock, extends the hour clock specification from the HourClock module by adding a liveness condition. It defines a specification LSpec that requires the hour clock to behave as in HourClock (HC) and also to satisfy a weak fairness condition on the hour clock's next action (HCnxt). The module introduces temporal properties such as AlwaysTick (infinitely many HCnxt steps occur), AllTimes (every hour value 1..12 is seen infinitely often), and TypeInvariance (the initial condition HCini is always true). A theorem is stated showing that LSpec implies all these properties. The module also defines a property ClockSettles (the clock eventually settles on some hour forever) and a PostCondition with a detailed counterexample trace structure. The design demonstrates how to specify liveness and temporal properties for a simple cyclic system.
